posts.author: Amit_Lamba
posts.text: Pulled the actual quarterly numbers to check a couple of claims in this thread (source: BullKarma — disclosure, I built it, not pitching it): EBITDA margin has actually declined for 4 straight quarters — 11.5% (Q2 FY26) → 9.4% (Q1 FY27). The steel-cost risk flagged upthread isn’t hypothetical anymore, it’s in the last four prints. Q1 FY27 revenue grew 23.9% YoY (₹295→366 Cr) — close to management’s revised “min 20%” guide, well below the original 30-35%, and nowhere near the “60%” figure from post #5 (likely an early small-base quarter). post #5 yes 60% growth is abnormal and unsustainable but…
